summary: Implementation plan to clean up and refine DAYZERO UI and wallpaper canvas: removing the top bar (DAYZERO / Pixel 9 branding and sync icon), removing 'Pixel 9 Preview' text, centering the Pure/Lock/Home overlay toggle, removing the bottom wallpaper footer stamp ('Automatic Daily Update Pixel 9 Active'), simplifying 'Apply to Pixel 9' to 'Apply', and removing the display spec subtext.
